$comment: Copy this into Claude Desktop's config, replacing /ABSOLUTE/PATH/TO with the
path to your clone. Claude Desktop starts the server from its own working
directory, so the path to index.js has to be absolute.
Run `npm install && npm run build` once first: this launches the compiled
Every value in env is optional. With no GROQ_API_KEY the agent parses intent
deterministically instead of with a model; with no Razorpay keys the gateway
runs an in-process mock and no real money moves. The verification engine is
identical either way. Set ACTOR_HMAC_SECRET to a real secret before running
this anywhere but your own machine.
